svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-mrr-to-net-margin-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Monthly ARPU to net owner operating margin; subtitle: Illustrative $150/mo B2B account on unsubsidized compute; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per $150 monthly subscription receipt; opening and closing bars are totals, middle bars are deductions.; caption: Even after startup cloud credits expire, model routing and semantic caching preserve >80% SaaS gross margin and 30%-45% net margin.; stages: label: Monthly ARPU; value: $150.00; numeric value: 150.0; detail: Hybrid $99 base workspace plus $51 average metered workflow and seat expansion.; label: LLM & vector compute; value: -$14.50; numeric value: -14.5; detail: Unsubsidized tiered model inference, embeddings, and managed Postgres/queue allocation.; label: Billing & tax rail; value: -$7.50; numeric value: -7.5; detail: Stripe Billing + Tax or Merchant-of-Record processing and failed-card retry overhead.; label: Churn & refund drag; value: -$9.00; numeric value: -9.0; detail: Amortized involuntary/voluntary churn and prorated ROSCA cancellation credits.; label: Contractor & GTM pod; value: -$51.50; numeric value: -51.5; detail: Allocated part-time engineering, support automation, and acquisition spend at scale.; label: Owner net contribution; value: $67.50; numeric value: 67.5; detail: 45% scaled small-team owner margin before personal income taxes and R&D tax timing.
